directionSummary: Warm-but-clinically-grounded telehealth marketplace. Premium, aspirational polish on the public landing and catalog; quiet clinical clarity on auth, intake, and orders. Warm off-white paper base with tinted neutrals, anchored by a single deep botanical-green primary that signals real, modern medicine over reflexive medical-teal or supplement-bright palettes, with a muted terracotta secondary for human warmth. Not stark clinical white, not a dark tech theme. Landing earns trust through editorial generosity; intake earns it through calm, private, section-by-section pacing with reassuring microcopy.

brand.mood: Reassuring and grounded. Confident without being loud; warm without being soft on safety.

palette.colorStrategy: Restrained on product surfaces (tinted neutrals + one accent); Committed green on landing brand moments. All neutrals warm-tinted toward the green hue; no pure #000 or #fff.

typography.display: Humanist serif for landing hero and major section headlines (e.g. Fraunces, Source Serif, or Newsreader). Large sizes on marketing surfaces only; not used for product chrome.
typography.body: Clean humanist sans for all body, forms, labels, tables, and product UI (e.g. Inter, or warmer Hanken Grotesk / Mulish). Carries the full intake and orders experience.
notes: Weight contrast: regular body, semibold labels, serif reserved for display
Body line length capped 65-75ch on landing long-form
Intake and orders are sans-only for calm, legible, EHR-grade reading without coldness

layout.direction: Spacious editorial on landing/catalog; balanced-to-compact on authenticated product surfaces. Density matched to surface, not one global setting.
layout.navigation: Public top nav with prominent Get Started CTA on landing/catalog; viewport-centered auth with brand above form and no app chrome; intake runs as a stand-alone funnel surface with main nav hidden; My Orders uses a minimal top bar (no heavy sidebar in this slice).
notes: Alternate full-bleed and contained sections with varied spacing for rhythm
Avoid wrapping everything in containers; let some sections breathe full-width
No identical card grids; vary section structure

surfaces: Soft, lightly elevated cards on warm surface tint
forms: Generous field height (44px+), labels above inputs
Soft borders deepening to green on focus with a calm focus ring
Roomy spacing on intake; low-anxiety, no dense gridlock
Quiet, instructive error states; never red-flashing
actions: Single primary per view: solid deep green, white text
Secondary: outline or low-tint; tertiary: text link
Radius matching cards; confident but not glowing (no neon CTA)
dataDisplay: My Orders as status cards / list rows
Calm status pill system (Intake Complete, Order Placed, Pending Review) mapped to muted semantic palette
Status never conveyed by color alone; pair with label/icon
Real patient data, not a metrics-dashboard template

intakeFunnel.header: standard (logo + app name, breathing room, no tagline, main nav hidden)
intakeFunnel.progressIndicator: numbered step circles with section labels on desktop; thin progress bar on mobile
intakeFunnel.stepRhythm: grouped questions per section (one screen per section, 3-6 fields)
intakeFunnel.tone: warm-and-reassuring (microcopy explains why sensitive questions are asked; soft framing on allergies and medications)
intakeFunnel.resumeLater: subtle text link in the funnel header (signup-first, no guest mode)
intakeFunnel.transitions: slide-from-right on Next, fade on Back
intakeFunnel.mobileHeader: sticky logo + thin progress bar; drops step labels

principles: Ease-out exponential curves; no bounce or elastic
Landing: gentle reveal-on-scroll, soft hover lifts
Intake: slide-from-right on Next, fade on Back
Loading and status changes resolve quietly

references.label: No reference assets provided
references.rationale: Direction derived from product positioning (real prescribing telehealth, premium consumer health) and the patient trust journey rather than uploaded references.
